description: Package.json Scripts Enhancement - Add missing scripts for quality, documentation, and CI/CD. Ensure all necessary npm scripts exist.
steps: Add lint:strict script that fails on warnings: "lint:strict": "eslint . --max-warnings 0"
Add test:comprehensive script if missing (currently references test:v3, test:git, etc.)
Add clean script to remove generated files: "clean": "rm -rf coverage test-results"
Add prepack script for npm publishing preparation
Add docs:validate script if there's a way to validate documentation links
Ensure prepare script exists for Husky (already have postinstall)
Add all scripts referenced in CI workflows if missing
Update package.json exports field to include TypeScript definition files if they will be created
acceptance_criteria: npm run scripts all work without errors
